title.narrative: Production and marketing of panela, and other organic products for communities affected by the gerrilas, (Asoprovegas, Aseas, and Asoagro) in the Municipality of Tulua, Valle del Cauca, Colombia

description.narrative: Asociacin de Productores de Panela de la Vereda Las Vegas (Asoprovegas) will work with its members and two other grassroots organizations in the municipality of Tulua, department of Valle del Cauca, Asociacin de Escuelas Agroecolgicas Campesinas de San Rafael (Aseas) and the Asociacin de Agricultores Orgnicos de San Lorenzo (Asoagro), toward better land-use practices on 57 farms, resulting in the increased production of sugar cane and a more reliable food supply. Goals include as well greater collaboration among the three organizations. The project is expected to benefit Colombians 170 directly and another 470 indirectly. Next, Asoprovegas will continue to work with its members toward better land-use practices on 28 additional farms, resulting in a more reliable food supply, increased collaboration among the three organizations and three additional organizations in the region, and increased income for approximately 80 young people. The project is expected to benefit Colombians 100 directly and another 200 indirectly.
